description: Every Hostex v3 operation, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers cross-property questions no single Hostex call can — occupancy gaps, revenue rollups, and guest-message SLA, offline.

tools.name: automation_delete-action
tools.description: Removes a **waiting** message or review automation plan without running it (same as deleting an upcoming action in the app). Requires a **writable** access token. Only `send_message` and `review` plan types are supported. Required: plan_id. Returns the CommonResponse. Destructive.

params.name: plan_id
params.description: Automation plan id from `GET /automation/actions` (`data.actions[].id`).

tools.name: automation_execute-action
tools.description: Dispatches a **waiting** message or review automation plan immediately (same behavior as executing an upcoming action in the app). For **review** plans, the reservation must have reached check-out date in the operator timezone. Requires a **writable** access token. Only `send_message` and `review` plan types are supported. Required: plan_id. Returns the new CommonResponse.

params.name: plan_id
params.description: Automation plan id from `GET /automation/actions` (`data.actions[].id`).

tools.name: automation_query-actions
tools.description: Returns scheduled automation **actions** that are waiting to run: either automated **messages** (`type=message`, same scope as the in-app “upcoming message actions” list, within the next 30 days) or automated **reviews** (`type=review`). Filters mirror the internal automation plan lists (keyword, property IDs, time range, channel types, rule event filters). Pagination uses `offset` and `limit` like other v3 list endpoints. Required: type. Optional: keyword, stay_code, property_ids (plus 5 more).

params.name: type
params.description: Kind of scheduled action: `message` for automated guest messages, `review` for scheduled host reviews.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Optional text matched against the plan detail payload (same as the in-app keyword filter).

params.name: stay_code
params.description: The code of the stay.

params.name: property_ids
params.description: Enter property IDs to search. Comma-separated integer IDs (e.g. `1,2,3`) or a JSON array string (e.g. `[1,2,3]`).

params.name: start_time
params.description: Include only actions scheduled at or after this time (inclusive). ISO 8601 or `Y-m-d H:i:s` as accepted by date validation.

params.name: end_time
params.description: Include only actions scheduled at or before this time (inclusive).

params.name: channel_types
params.description: Filter by channel types. Comma-separated channel names, e.g. `airbnb,agoda`.

params.name: offset
params.description: Zero-based index of the first row to return. Default: 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1–100). Default: 20.

tools.name: availabilities_query
tools.description: By sending a request to this endpoint, you can retrieve the availabilities of the properties. Required: property_ids, start_date, end_date. Returns the AvailabilitiesQueryResponse.

params.name: property_ids
params.description: Enter property IDs to search, separating them with commas (,). A maximum of 100 properties can be queried at once.

params.name: start_date
params.description: The start date for records. The date format is YYYY-MM-DD, and must be within 1 years from now.

params.name: end_date
params.description: The end date for records. The date format is YYYY-MM-DD, and must be within 3 years from now.

tools.name: availabilities_update
tools.description: Use this endpoint to update property availabilities. Please be aware that a successful response indicates only that we have initiated an asynchronous task to handle your submission; it DOES NOT ensure that the channel inventories have been modified successfully. If you wish to view detailed results of the task execution, please visit the [Host Portal](https://hostex.io/app/calendar). Required: available, property_ids. Optional: dates, end_date, start_date. Returns the new CommonResponse.

params.name: available
params.description: Set the availability status: `true` for available or `false` for unavailable.

params.name: dates
params.description: Provide a list of dates for the update in YYYY-MM-DD format. Dates must be today's date or later. If `start_date` and `end_date` are specified, the list of dates will not be considered.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Specify the update's end date using the YYYY-MM-DD format. This must be a future date within 3 years from now. If omitted, the `dates` becomes mandatory.

params.name: property_ids
params.description: Specify the property IDs to update.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Specify the update's start date using the YYYY-MM-DD format. This must be either the current date or a future date. If omitted, the `dates` becomes mandatory.

tools.name: calendar-share-links_create
tools.description: Create a new public calendar share link. `scope = entire` exposes every property in the operator's account; `scope = partial` exposes only the properties listed in `property_ids`. Each operator can have at most one entire-scope link: requesting one when it already exists simply returns the existing link. Required: scope. Optional: property_ids.

params.name: property_ids
params.description: Required (non-empty) when `scope = partial`. Each id must reference a property owned by the operator.

params.name: scope
params.description: `entire` exposes every property of the operator; `partial` exposes only the ids listed in `property_ids`.

tools.name: calendar-share-links_delete
tools.description: Permanently invalidate a calendar share link. The public URL will start returning a `share link invalid` error to anyone who tries to open it. Required: id. Returns the CommonResponse. Destructive.

params.name: id
params.description: Internal share link id (from `search_calendar_share_links`).

tools.name: calendar-share-links_query
tools.description: List the operator's public calendar share links. Each link exposes a read-only calendar (and reservation list) of either every property (`scope = entire`) or a selected subset (`scope = partial`) and is reachable by anyone who has the URL. Optional: offset, limit, id. Returns the CalendarShareLinksQueryResponse.

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset. Defaults to 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Defaults to 20. Max 100.

params.name: id
params.description: Fetch a single share link by its internal id.

tools.name: channel-accounts_query
tools.description: Query the third-party channel accounts (Airbnb, Booking.com, etc.) that the operator has connected. Each entry exposes the account identity and current authorization status. Use `id` to fetch a single account. Optional: id, channel_type, offset (default: 0) (plus 1 more). Returns the ChannelAccountsQueryResponse.

params.name: id
params.description: Internal id of a specific channel account.

params.name: channel_type
params.description: Filter by channel type.

params.name: offset
params.description: The starting point from which to begin returning results. Default: 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. The maximum value is 100. Default: 20.

tools.name: conversations_get-details
tools.description: This endpoint is used to retrieve the messages and details of a conversation. We are constantly improving our API which could mean that message schema may change. In order to maintain a healthy integration, your Application must parse and ignore unexpected parameters instead of throwing errors. Required: conversation_id. Returns the ConversationsGetDetailsResponse.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: The id of the conversation.

tools.name: conversations_query
tools.description: This endpoint is used to query the list of conversations regarding guest inquiries. Optional: offset (default: 0), limit (default: 20). Returns the ConversationsQueryResponse.

params.name: offset
params.description: Specifies the starting index from which the results should be returned.

params.name: limit
params.description: Determines the maximum number of results to be returned, up to a maximum of 100.

tools.name: conversations_send-message
tools.description: Send a text or image message to the guest. Required: conversation_id. Optional: jpeg_base64, message. Returns the new CommonResponse.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: The id of the conversation.

params.name: jpeg_base64
params.description: The base64 encoded string of the JPEG image.

params.name: message
params.description: The text content of the message. Max length depends on the limit of different channels.

tools.name: conversations_note_update-conversation
tools.description: Set or clear the host's private note attached to a conversation thread. The note is stored only in Hostex (visible in the Hostex Inbox), is **never** sent to the guest or pushed to any channel, and is shared across operators inside the same account. Pass an empty string or `null` in `note` to clear the existing note. Required: conversation_id, note. Returns the updated NoteUpdateConversationResponse.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: The id of the conversation.

params.name: note
params.description: The host-side private note. Pass an empty string or `null` to clear the existing note. Max 5000 characters.

tools.name: conversations_preapprovals_send
tools.description: Pre-approve the guest's inquiry in a conversation, inviting them to book the listing and dates they asked about at the standard price. Supported on Airbnb conversations only; requests on other channels return an error. The pre-approval typically expires 24 hours after being sent. No request body is required. Required: conversation_id. Returns the new CommonResponse.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: The id of the conversation.

tools.name: conversations_special-offers_get
tools.description: List the special offers and pre-approvals that have been sent in a conversation, with their current status. Use the returned `id` to withdraw an offer that is still active. Only Airbnb and booking-site (direct booking) conversations can contain special offers. Required: conversation_id. Returns the SpecialOffersGetResponse.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: The id of the conversation.

tools.name: conversations_special-offers_send
tools.description: Send a special offer to the guest in a conversation. A special offer invites the guest to book the given listing for the given dates at a custom total price, and typically expires 24 hours after being sent. Supported on Airbnb and booking-site (direct booking) conversations only; requests on other channels return an error. For booking-site conversations, `rate_plan_id` and `currency` are also required. Required: conversation_id, check_in_date, check_out_date, listing_id, number_of_adults, price. Optional: currency, number_of_children, number_of_infants (plus 2 more). Returns the new CommonResponse.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: The id of the conversation.

params.name: check_in_date
params.description: Check-in date of the offered stay, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

params.name: check_out_date
params.description: Check-out date of the offered stay, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Must be after `check_in_date`.

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency code of `price`, e.g. `USD`. Required for booking-site (direct booking) conversations; ignored on Airbnb.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: The channel listing id to offer, as returned by `GET /listings`.

params.name: number_of_adults
params.description: Number of adults.

params.name: number_of_children
params.description: Number of children. Defaults to 0.

params.name: number_of_infants
params.description: Number of infants. Defaults to 0.

params.name: number_of_pets
params.description: Number of pets. Defaults to 0.

params.name: price
params.description: Total price for the whole stay, in major currency units (not per night).

params.name: rate_plan_id
params.description: The rate plan to offer. Required for booking-site (direct booking) conversations; ignored on Airbnb.

tools.name: conversations_special-offers_withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw a previously sent special offer or pre-approval that is still active. `special_offer_id` is the offer `id` returned by `GET /conversations/{conversation_id}/special_offers`. Required: conversation_id, special_offer_id. Returns the CommonResponse. Destructive.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: The id of the conversation.

params.name: special_offer_id
params.description: The id of the special offer, as returned by `GET /conversations/{conversation_id}/special_offers`.

tools.name: custom-channels_query
tools.description: Query custom channels created from the [Custom Options Page](https://hostex.io/app/settings/custom-options). Returns the CustomChannelsQueryResponse.

tools.name: expense-items_query
tools.description: Query the dictionary of expense item categorizations available to the operator. The returned `id` matches the `item_id` returned by `GET /transactions` for entries with `direction=expense`. Returns the ExpenseItemsQueryResponse.

tools.name: expense-methods_query
tools.description: Query the dictionary of payment methods available to the operator for expense entries. The returned `id` matches the `payment_method_id` returned by `GET /transactions` for entries with `direction=expense`. Returns the ExpenseMethodsQueryResponse.

tools.name: groups_create
tools.description: Create a new property group. Optionally pre-attach properties at creation time via `property_ids`. The group name must be unique within the operator's account. Required: name. Optional: property_ids. Returns the new GroupsCreateResponse.

params.name: name
params.description: Group display name. Max 50 characters. Must be unique within the operator's account.

params.name: property_ids
params.description: Optional list of property ids to attach to the new group. Each id must belong to the operator.

tools.name: groups_delete
tools.description: Delete a property group. All property-group pivot rows are removed automatically; the underlying properties themselves are unaffected. Required: id. Returns the CommonResponse. Destructive.

params.name: id
params.description: Internal group id (from `search_property_groups`).

tools.name: groups_query
tools.description: You can query property groups by making a request to this endpoint. Optional: offset (default: 0), limit (default: 20), id. Returns the GroupsQueryResponse.

params.name: offset
params.description: The starting point from which to begin returning results.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. The maximum value is 100.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the group.

tools.name: groups_update
tools.description: Update a property group. Pass `name` to rename it; pass `property_ids` to **replace** the group's full property assignment with the supplied list (pass an empty array to detach all properties). Omitted fields are left unchanged. Required: id. Optional: name, property_ids. Returns the updated CommonResponse.

params.name: id
params.description: Internal group id (from `search_property_groups`).

params.name: name

tools.name: income-items_query
tools.description: Query the dictionary of income item categorizations available to the operator. The returned `id` matches the `item_id` returned by `GET /transactions` for entries with `direction=income`. Returns the IncomeItemsQueryResponse.

tools.name: income-methods_query
tools.description: Query the dictionary of payment methods available to the operator for income entries. The returned `id` matches the `payment_method_id` returned by `GET /transactions` for entries with `direction=income`. Returns the IncomeMethodsQueryResponse.

tools.name: knowledge-bases_create
tools.description: Create a new knowledge base entry for the HostGPT automation assistant. The entry defines AI content and the property/channel scope where it applies. Required: contents, is_enable, scope_channel, scope_property. Optional: title. Returns the new CommonResponse.

params.name: scope-channel-type
params.description: Channel scope type: all or by_channel.

params.name: scope-property-ids
params.description: Scope IDs interpreted according to `type`: property IDs for `by_property`, group IDs for `by_group`, room type IDs for `by_room_type`. Use `[-1]` for `all`.

params.name: scope-property-type
params.description: The type of property scope.

params.name: title
params.description: Optional title for the knowledge base entry.

tools.name: knowledge-bases_delete
tools.description: Delete a knowledge base entry by its ID. Required: id. Returns the CommonResponse. Destructive.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the knowledge base entry to delete.

tools.name: knowledge-bases_get
tools.description: Retrieve the full details of a single knowledge base entry by its ID. Required: id. Returns the KnowledgeBasesGetResponse.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the knowledge base entry.

tools.name: knowledge-bases_query
tools.description: You can query knowledge base entries by making a request to this endpoint. Results are paginated and can be filtered by property or channel. Optional: offset (default: 0), limit (default: 10), property_ids (plus 1 more). Returns the KnowledgeBasesQueryResponse.

params.name: offset

params.name: limit

params.name: property_ids

params.name: channel_types

Use `GET /knowledge_bases/{id}` first if you only want to change one field. Required: id, contents, is_enable, scope_channel, scope_property. Optional: title. Returns the updated CommonResponse.

params.name: id

params.name: contents

params.name: scope-channel-channels
params.description: Channel names this knowledge base applies to (e.g. `['airbnb', 'booking.com']`). Use `['unlimited']` for `all`. See [Supported Channels](/reference/supported-channels).

params.name: scope-channel-type
params.description: Channel scope type: all or by_channel.

params.name: scope-property-ids
params.description: Scope IDs interpreted according to `type`: property IDs for `by_property`, group IDs for `by_group`, room type IDs for `by_room_type`. Use `[-1]` for `all`.

params.name: title

tools.name: listings_get-airbnb-price-and-rules
tools.description: Fetch the current pricing, availability rules and booking settings of an Airbnb listing in real time from Airbnb. The response fields mirror the `settings` object accepted by `POST /listings/airbnb/price_and_rules`, so values read here can be written back as-is. This endpoint calls multiple Airbnb APIs per request and therefore shares the stricter rate limit of write operations (120 requests per minute). Required: listing_id. Returns the ListingsGetAirbnbPriceAndRulesResponse.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: The Airbnb listing id.

tools.name: listings_get-vrbo-price-and-rules
tools.description: Get the pricing and rules of a Vrbo listing as currently recorded by Hostex. The data is the snapshot Hostex keeps in sync with Vrbo (updated when changes are made through Hostex or the listing is re-synced), not a real-time read from Vrbo. The response fields mirror the `settings` object accepted by `POST /listings/vrbo/price_and_rules`. Required: listing_id. Returns the ListingsGetVrboPriceAndRulesResponse.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: The Vrbo listing id.

tools.name: listings_query

A listing is a property as it exists on a specific channel, identified by `listing_id` (the channel-side property id). params.name: channel_account_id

params.name: listing_id

params.name: channel_type
params.description: Filter by channel type.

params.name: offset

params.name: limit

tools.name: pricing-ratios_query
tools.description: Return the per-channel pricing ratio of each OTA listing linked to a property (`property_id`) or a room type (`room_type_id`). Pricing ratio is the **percentage** Hostex multiplies a base (property/room-type level) price by to derive the actual price pushed to each listing. Use this endpoint at the skill layer to compose a 'change price by property / room type' workflow: read the ratios, compute `target_price = round(base_price * ratio / 100)` for every non-readonly listing, then call `POST /listings/prices` once per listing. Listings marked `readonly: true` are silently controlled by the channel (e.g. Airbnb child rate plans) and cannot be repriced via `POST /listings/prices`; skip them. Optional: property_id, room_type_id. Returns the PricingRatiosQueryResponse.

tools.name: transactions_create
tools.description: Record a new income or expense entry. What the entry is linked to is inferred from the request: - provide `stay_code` to record an entry against a specific stay, - provide `property_id` to record an entry against a specific property, - provide neither to record an operator-level entry (not tied to any specific property or stay; only available to the master operator). `stay_code` and `property_id` are mutually exclusive. The `direction` field decides whether the entry is an `income` or an `expense`, which in turn determines which dictionaries are used for `item_id` (`GET /income_items` or `GET /expense_items`) and `payment_method_id` (`GET /income_methods` or `GET /expense_methods`). The `amount` is always provided as a positive number; the sign is derived from `direction`. The `currency` accompanies the amount and must be supplied unless `stay_code` is provided, in which case it is inherited from the reservation order and, if you do provide it, it must match the order's currency. Required: amount, direction, item_id, payment_method_id. Optional: action_at, currency, note (plus 2 more). Returns the new TransactionsCreateResponse.

params.name: action_at
params.description: When the action took place. Accepts ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`). Defaults to the current time. If set to a future time the entry is created with status `outstanding`; otherwise it is `paid`.

params.name: amount
params.description: Absolute amount of the entry. Always provide a positive value; the sign is derived from `direction`.

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency code that accompanies `amount`. Required unless `stay_code` is provided; reservation-linked entries inherit the currency from the order and reject mismatching values. See [Supported Currencies](/reference/supported-currencies) for more information.

params.name: direction
params.description: Whether this entry represents money received (`income`) or money spent (`expense`).

params.name: item_id
params.description: The id of the item categorization. Must be a valid id from `GET /income_items` when `direction=income`, or from `GET /expense_items` when `direction=expense`.

params.name: note
params.description: Free-form note (max 500 characters).

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: The id of the payment method. Must be a valid id from `GET /income_methods` when `direction=income`, or from `GET /expense_methods` when `direction=expense`.

params.name: property_id
params.description: The id of the property to record the entry against. Mutually exclusive with `stay_code`. Omit both to record an operator-level entry.

params.name: stay_code
params.description: The `stay_code` (returned by `GET /reservations`) of the stay to record the entry against. Mutually exclusive with `property_id`. Omit both to record an operator-level entry.

tools.name: transactions_delete
tools.description: Delete a transaction entry. The operation is irreversible. Returns 404 if the entry does not exist or is not accessible to the current operator. Required: id. Destructive.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the transaction entry to delete.

tools.name: transactions_query
tools.description: Query income and expense entries (also known as `transactions`) recorded against the operator, properties or reservations. The response provides each entry with its categorization (`item_id` / `item_name`) and payment method (`payment_method_id` / `payment_method_name`). The values of `item_id` and `payment_method_id` reference the dictionaries returned by `GET /income_items`, `GET /expense_items`, `GET /income_methods` and `GET /expense_methods` (which dictionary applies depends on `direction`). Optional: id, start_date, end_date (plus 9 more). Returns the TransactionsQueryResponse.

params.name: id
params.description: Internal id of a specific transaction entry. When supplied, returns at most one matching entry under the current operator; `start_date` and `end_date` may then be omitted.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start of the action time range, inclusive. Format `YYYY-MM-DD`. Interpreted in the operator's configured timezone. Required unless `id` is supplied.

params.name: end_date
params.description: End of the action time range, inclusive. Format `YYYY-MM-DD`. Interpreted in the operator's configured timezone. The range from `start_date` to `end_date` cannot exceed 366 days. Required unless `id` is supplied.

params.name: offset
params.description: The starting point from which to begin returning results.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. The maximum value is 100.

params.name: property_id
params.description: Filter entries linked to the given property id (either directly recorded against the property, or indirectly through a reservation on this property).

params.name: stay_code
params.description: Filter entries linked to the given stay (the `stay_code` returned by `GET /reservations`).

params.name: direction
params.description: Filter by direction: `income` for money received, `expense` for money spent.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Filter by item id (the categorization of the entry). For income entries the id refers to `GET /income_items`; for expense entries it refers to `GET /expense_items`.

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: Filter by payment method id. For income entries the id refers to `GET /income_methods`; for expense entries it refers to `GET /expense_methods`.

params.name: currency
params.description: Filter by currency code. See [Supported Currencies](/reference/supported-currencies) for more information.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Substring match on the entry `note`.

tools.name: transactions_update
tools.description: Update an existing transaction entry. Only the fields listed below can be modified. The entry's `direction`, link target (related property / reservation / operator) and `currency` are immutable; if you need to change any of these, delete the entry and create a new one. Required: id. Optional: action_at, amount, item_id (plus 2 more). Returns the updated CommonResponse.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the transaction entry returned by `GET /transactions` or `POST /transactions`.

params.name: action_at
params.description: New action time. Accepts ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`).

params.name: amount
params.description: New absolute amount. Always provide a positive value; the original `direction` (income or expense) is preserved.

params.name: item_id
params.description: New item categorization id. Must be a valid id from `GET /income_items` when the entry's direction is `income`, or `GET /expense_items` when it is `expense`.

params.name: note
params.description: New free-form note (max 500 characters).

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: New payment method id. Must be a valid id from `GET /income_methods` when the entry's direction is `income`, or `GET /expense_methods` when it is `expense`.
